comment: Explicit overrides: the index entry (Package, Version, Architecture) points its Filename at this GitHub release asset instead of debs/<file>. Read by scripts/override-filenames.py at build time. The asset must be the same file as debs/<file> (same size and SHA256), or the build fails. Everything not listed here stays on debs/. Empty: packages that exist only as release assets are listed in data/release-packages.json instead, and that list is what the build reads for them.
